about: Wild creature spawn rows of gull_skerries, one record per server row (spawn | gull_skerries | creature | x | y | leash:N). Positions are territory-local metres (x east, z south), the source of truth; the served tile is derived when the server rows are written (_continent_v2/frames.py), never stored here. Re-seat a row by editing its local position here, never in a served file.

fields.zone: the plan zone the row was drawn in
fields.note: why a row moved or changed species (only where it did)
